items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I got together with Illinois Jacquet, who we had played together, we had played together with Lionel Hampton, and we organized a band together.

ctx.x: That was about 1946. I think sometimes I forget to really pinpoint these years, but then you led a band -- co-led a band with Illinois Jacquet, 1947-48.

Well, during the time I was playing with Coleman Hawkins which was after I played with Lucky Millinder, when I got to California as I said, the bookings sort of petered out and rather than to continue on the road with these uncertainties, I got together with Illinois Jacquet, who we had played together, we had played together with Lionel Hampton, and we organized a band together. We played in San Diego -- San Diego, yes. We played a job in San Diego. It didn't last too long, but we had Henry Coker on trombone and…
